live_finding.run: ipv4live - real DeepSeek, 4 diverse cells, 3 rounds, 12 candidates
live_finding.what_happened: Every cell used str.isdigit() (one cell's own comment even said 'ASCII digits'), which returns True for U+0664 (Arabic-Indic digit four); int() then parses it, so is_valid('1.1.1.<U+0664>') wrongly returns True. The external oracle caught the 1/14 miss the whole swarm shared and were confident about.
live_finding.lesson: Temperature/angle diversity WITHIN one provider family shares a blind spot, so 3 rounds of cross-pollination could not repair it. HC-4 sharpened: real diversity needs DIFFERENT PROVIDER FAMILIES. Only DEEPSEEK_API_KEY was present; add a second family (cerebras/glm/...) and one cell likely uses isascii() and wins. The oracle is the keystone precisely because the swarm cannot see its own shared gap.
